title: (‡‡): at reduced-boundary points the blow-ups η_{x,r}(E) converge in L¹_loc to the half-space {⟨y, ν_E(x)⟩ > 0}
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, E ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable and (μ, ν) a Gauss-Green pair for (U, E) (IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν). Let x ∈ ∂*E := reducedBoundary U μ ν, ν_E(x) := reducedNormal μ ν x and H := {y : ⟨y, ν_E(x)⟩ > 0}. Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N, L^N(K ∩ (η_{x,r}(E) Δ H)) → 0 as r ↓ 0, where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) (blowUpMap).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, ∀ K : Set (Rn (n + 1)), IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (K ∩ symmDiff (blowUpMap x r '' E) {y | 0 < inner ℝ y (reducedNormal μ ν x)})) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
